text.p: This view is a summary for DevAlert traces. The Latest Trace links can be clicked to fetch the trace from the cloud and open them in $PNAME.
If new alerts are detected, they will be shown at the top, and will be highlighted with red color.

When starting the Dashboard (from the Welcome screen, or from the Dashboard tool directly), a login to DevAlert Console is needed. If the password is saved in settings (not default option), the connect will be done directly. If not, the Sign in note will be shown. Click the highlighted link to get the login dialog, and when logged in the issue list will load.

If the Dashboard has problems loading, an error message will be shown. Then either go to the direct settings for either the Core or the Storage settings, or use the link to go through the DevAlert Connection Wizard.
